Package it.polimi.ingsw.client

Class Client

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.Client
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClientRMI, ClientSocket
public abstract class Client extends Object
This class handles the interactions between the user and the server.

    • coordsToJson

      org.json.JSONArray coordsToJson(ArrayList<Coordinate> coords) throws NullPointerException
      This method transforms the coordinates gathered by the user into a JSON object that will then be parsed by the server in order to validate them.
      Parameters:
      coords - The ArrayList containing the coordinates chosen by the user.
      Returns:
      The JSONObject containing a JSONArray with the aforementioned coordinates.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - If the ArrayList of coordinates passed is empty, this exception is thrown

    • parseMoveInput

      ArrayList<Coordinate> parseMoveInput(String input) throws IllegalStateException
      This method parses the coordinate input from the user with a regex matching and returns an ArrayList of coordinates with all the matches it found.
      Parameters:
      input - The input string gathered from the user.
      Returns:
      An ArrayList of Coordinate objects that contain the coordinates gathered from the user.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - If the input string is empty or contains more than three coordinates, this exception is thrown

    • tileValidation

      Message tileValidation()
      This method is used to validate and package the tiles in a Message to be sent to the server.
      Returns:
      a Message object with SEND_TILES as a header and the JSON representation of the selected tiles as the body.
